about: Flow Control, a fast text editor for programmers that runs in the terminal.

prs.title: Opening a file link keeps its line number
prs.broken: Opening a file link that names a line, from the cursor, always landed on line 1, so the line and column were lost.
prs.changed: The editor now passes the full link, with line and column, when it opens the file.
prs.matters: Jumping from an error message to the exact spot in the code works again.
